concerns.location: plan.md: Complexity Tracking table, FR-011 row
concerns.text: FR-011 is mapped to 'Phase 3 — permutation validation on real pipeline inputs', but the plan's Phase 3 text says validation runs on 'null synthetic data'. FR-011 explicitly requires validation 'on real data'; substituting synthetic null-data false-positive checks validates the machinery, not the pipeline-on-real-data as the spec demands. State explicitly that FR-011's real-data clause is deferred alongside FR-001 (with the same re-plan trigger) rather than claiming it is covered.

The plan honestly flags that no verified dataset exists and the scientific question remains unanswered, but the re-plan trigger is only mentioned in passing ('A re-plan is triggered when a verified dataset is identified'). Add a concrete, testable trigger condition (e.g., a named dataset passing the verified-dataset gate with both adolescent rs-fMRI and a training variable) so the deferred real-data path is actionable rather than aspirational.
